name: Lim-Dûl
description: Planeswalker entombed in stone by Leshrac who reemerged with new powers and deceived Bani and Ravash disguised as Magus.

description_citations.text: "War for Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl calls for the gates to be opened for the dead.
timeline.quote: "Open the gates, and bid them enter."

citation.text: Abyssal Specter (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl swears his service to Leshrac and asks for power.
timeline.quote: "Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."

citation.text: Dark Ritual (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl orders the dead of his enemies entombed in snow to rise as servants.
timeline.quote: "Take their dead, and entomb them in the snow. Risen, they shall serve a new purpose."

citation.text: Drift of the Dead (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl swears himself to Leshrac, body and soul.
timeline.quote: Blood for blood, flesh for flesh, Leshrac, my lord."

citation.text: Leshrac's Rite (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl boasts his Moor Fiends will rend Krov's people.
timeline.quote: My fiends shall yet rend their flesh from their bones."

citation.text: Moor Fiend (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lucilde sees the faces of her dead friends among Lim-Dûl's legions.
timeline.quote: "I have seen the faces of my dead friends among that grim band, and I can bear no more."

citation.text: Legions of Lim-Dûl (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lucilde's party chases Lim-Dûl when a ridge crumbles.
timeline.quote: "We were chasing Lim-Dûl when the ridge in front of us suddenly crumbled.

citation.text: Glacial Crevasses (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Arna Kennerüd vows to oppose Lim-Dûl by any means.
timeline.quote: "We shall oppose Lim-Dûl and his forces by any means necessary, even if the very earth be torn asunder."

citation.text: Reclamation (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dagsson argues artifacts helped them survive Lim-Dûl's horrors.
timeline.quote: Would Relicbane prefer we had been slain by Lim-Dûl's horrors?"

citation.text: Staff of the Ages (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya Ballard prevent an attack by the Knights of Stromgald on Darien and reveal Lim-Dûl's involvement.
timeline.quote: prevented an attack on Darien's life by the Knights of Stromgald and revealed that Lim-Dûl was behind it

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Darien consolidates his power, forms a single army under General Varchild, and allies with the Balduvians against Lim-Dûl.
timeline.quote: This allowed him to make an alliance with the Balduvians and lead an army against Lim-Dûl

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ten years after Lim-Dûl's first attacks, Disa leads an expedition west seeking allies against the necromancer, reaching a huge wall of ice and finding no one to help Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: Disa led an expedition into the west in the hope of finding allies to fight together against the necromancer.

citation.text: "Disa", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avram Garrisson arrives and reveals he allied himself with Lim-Dul and became undead.
timeline.quote: Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul, becoming undead

citation.text: "Disa", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor and Balduvia set aside their feud to face the necromancer Lim-Dûl.
timeline.quote: eventually set their problems aside to face the necromancer Lim-Dûl

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl unleashes a horde of undead, forcing old enemies to work together.
timeline.quote: when the necromancer Lim-Dûl unleashed a horde of undead , old enemies were forced to work together or be overwhelmed

citation.text: "Ice Age", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avram Garrisson arrives and reveals he allied with Lim-Dûl and became undead.
timeline.quote: Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul

citation.text: "Klazina Jansdotter", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl flees from a battle with goblins and, caught in a blizzard, finds the ring of Mairsil among the remains of the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl fled while the others were slaughtered.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ring grants Lim-Dûl great power; he builds Tresserhorn and becomes a necromancer, with Leshrac and Mairsil manipulating him.
timeline.quote: The ring granted him incredible powers that not only allowed him to survive the blizzard but also to become a powerful necromancer.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerda sells out Jodah, and Lim-Dûl muddles his memory and makes him research planes and ways to kill a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl had Jodah also research ways to kill a planeswalker

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac discovers the plan and mutates Lim-Dûl, giving him horns.
timeline.quote: Leshrac discovered this and mutated his minion, giving him horns

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl poisons the Knights of Stromgald when they plot a coup, zombifying them; Jodah saves King Darien and Kjeldor allies with the Balduvians.
timeline.quote: allowed Darien to unite them and forge an alliance with the Balduvians

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the last battle, Lim-Dûl faces Jodah under Mairsil's control, and Leshrac cuts off Lim-Dûl's hand and tears him apart.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl was turned into a living ball of raw flesh that Leshrac took with him off-plane

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerda trades Jodah to Lim-Dûl for the Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn, giving her access to a pool of black mana.
timeline.quote: In a bid for power, she exchanged Jodah in return for the Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn .

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl is defeated; Jodah survives and returns to rule, with Gerda as his second-in-command as punishment.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl was defeated in Lim-Dûl's Battle , but Jodah survived his ordeal and returned to rule the school

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl's armies burn the village of Breway.
timeline.quote: Breway - a small village, put to the torch by Lim-Dûl 's armies

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac warns Lim-Dûl of the coming darkness.
timeline.quote: Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither."

citation.text: Dark Banishing (Pro Tour Collector Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chaeska declares service to Lim-Dûl continues.
timeline.quote: "Whether whole or not, still we serve Lim-Dûl's wishes."

citation.text: Casting of Bones (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Halvor Arensson says Lim-Dûl's terrors remain.
timeline.quote: "We are not yet free of Lim-Dûl's terrors."

citation.text: Feast or Famine (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The new climate brings floods and plagues, and the necromancer Lim-Dûl builds an undead army bent on world domination.
timeline.quote: the necromancer Lim-Dûl has built an army of undead bent on world domination

citation.text: "Alliances", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The races form an alliance to defeat Lim-Dûl and his army.
timeline.quote: An alliance is formed between races to defeat Lim-Dûl and his army.

citation.text: "Alliances", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya rescues Jodah, who was drugged by Lim-Dûl, and summons Freyalise, promising her the school's resources for her World Spell.
timeline.quote: She destroyed the pollen-bearing flower and rescued him

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle Jaya defeats Chaeska with an unsummon and claims Lim-Dûl's severed hand, unaware it bears Mairsil's ring.
timeline.quote: Jaya was successful in her battle and later claimed Lim-Dûl's severed hand as a battle trophy

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya brings Jodah Lim-Dûl's hand with the ring finger missing, and they search for the ring.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Jaya set out to search for the missing ring

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerda and Gustha kidnap Jodah and give him to Lim-Dûl, who imprisons him in Tresserhorn and clouds his mind with Fyndhorn Pollen.
timeline.quote: They gave him to the necromancer Lim-Dûl , who imprisoned Jodah in Tresserhorn

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle, Jodah duels Lim-Dûl, until Leshrac cuts off Dûl's hand and takes him to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Leshrac took him to Phyrexia to be recreated

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya shows Jodah Lim-Dûl's severed hand with the ring finger missing and they set out to find the ring.
timeline.quote: the hand of Lim-Dûl and the ring finger were missing

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah smashes his mirror in Jaya's face, burning away Mairsil and Lim-Dûl and triggering Jaya's spark.
timeline.quote: smashed his mirror in Jaya's face

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil's ring coerces Jaya into picking it up; the possessed Jaya stabs Jodah at Soldev and destroys Soldev and the School of the Unseen, until Jaya ascends and expels the minds.
timeline.quote: Jaya ascended and removed the minds of Lim-Dûl and Mairsil from herself.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the time of the Shard of the Twelve Worlds, Faralyn, Tevesh Szat, Leshrac and Lim-Dûl invade Shandalar.
timeline.quote: They immediately began to wage war upon the plane, ready to claim it for their own.

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Sahrmal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sahrmal kills Faralyn with a summoned astral dragon and routs the others; Lim-Dûl injures Sahrmal, and Sahrmal's followers behead Lim-Dûl.
timeline.quote: managed to kill Faralyn with a summoned astral dragon

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Sahrmal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twelve years later Lim-Dûl returns with an undead army and destroys city after city until only Ardestan remains.
timeline.quote: City after city on the plane was destroyed until, after years of war, only one city remained, Ardestan .

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar's spell and Lim-Dûl's counter trap both spirits in Azar's body; Sahrmal secretly buries it as the Great Barrier forms.
timeline.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar's body.

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Wizards' War the five wizard schools resist Lim-Dûl, who is defeated; the Guardian imprisons his soul in an artifact.
timeline.quote: The Guardian removed Lim-Dûl's soul from Azar's body and imprisoned it within a magical artifact

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "The Wizards' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the prologue, the Kjeldoran soldier Lim-Dûl, trapped in a blizzard, finds a strange powerful ring in a cave.
timeline.quote: He manages to stumble into a small cave, where he finds a strange, powerful ring.

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah awakens at Tresserhorn and is told he is a summoned copy who must obey Lim-Dûl.
timeline.quote: The necromancer tells him he's a summoned copy of the original Jodah

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac mutates Lim-Dûl, revealing he forced the necromancer into his service.
timeline.quote: Leshrac mutates the necromancer by making him more animalistic and giving him horns

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya reveals Jodah is the real Jodah, drugged by Lim-Dûl, and they escape Tresserhorn.
timeline.quote: Jodah is not a summoned being but the real thing

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rebel Knights of Stromgald are revealed to be manipulated by Lim-Dûl, and Kjeldor allies with the Balduvians.
timeline.quote: allows the alliance with the Balduvians to be made

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah fights Lim-Dûl, revealed to be a blend of himself and Mairsil the Pretender; Lim-Dûl summons Leshrac, who rips him apart and takes him to the rogue plane.
timeline.quote: Leshrac rips the necromancer to shreds but keeps him alive during it all

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl destroys the School of the Unseen and Soldev.
timeline.quote: were destroyed by a vengeful Lim-Dûl

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Flood Ages". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl speaks of the Kjeldoran Dead killing those they loved.
timeline.quote: They shall kill those whom once they loved."

citation.text: Kjeldoran Dead (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kenan Sahrmal defends Shandalar, but Lim-Dûl is beheaded by Sahrmal's followers and survives by moving his soul to another body.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl had survived by transferring his soul into another body

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "War for Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twelve years later Lim-Dûl returns with an undead army and destroys city after city on Shandalar until only Ardestan remains.
timeline.quote: only one city remained: Ardestan

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar casts a spell to imprison Lim-Dûl's spirit and create the Great Barrier, but both spirits become trapped in Azar's body.
timeline.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar’s body.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar falls and Lim-Dûl resumes his campaign, but is finally defeated in the Wizard's War and his soul imprisoned in the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: imprisoned it within the Chain Veil , a magical artifact that kept the Great Barrier intact

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl and two planeswalkers escape imprisonment in the Shard and arrive on Shandalar; Sahrmal drives off all but Lim-Dûl, who stabs the weakened hero with a pitchfork before the followers behead him.
timeline.quote: The necromancer chose the aftermath of that battle as an advantageous moment to pierce Kenan Sahrmal with a pitchfork.

citation.text: "Magic: The Gathering (MicroProse)/Backstory", section "Preface". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twelve years later Lim-Dûl returns with an undead army and wages a years-long war that destroys every major city but one.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl reappeared with an army of the undead at his side and attempted to seize dominion over the entire plane.

citation.text: "Magic: The Gathering (MicroProse)/Backstory", section "Lim-Dûl’s return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ardestan is besieged; Azaar flees his teacher's sanctuary to defend it and steals Sahrmal's great spell.
timeline.quote: Azaar fled their hidden sanctuary and went to the defense of Ardestan.

citation.text: "Magic: The Gathering (MicroProse)/Backstory", section "The siege of Ardestan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl waits on a rooftop to transfer his spirit into Azaar's body as Azaar prepares his casting.
timeline.quote: Huddled in the questionable refuge of a Circle of Protection

citation.text: "Magic: The Gathering (MicroProse)/Backstory", section "The siege of Ardestan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azaar's spell strikes Lim-Dûl's spirit while it occupies Azaar's body, raising the Great Barrier and imprisoning both.
timeline.quote: It worked, but Lim-Dûl was in Azaar’s body at the time.

citation.text: "Magic: The Gathering (MicroProse)/Backstory", section "The Guardian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sahrmal secretly buries Azaar's paralyzed body, where the two spirits war for control.
timeline.quote: Sahrmal secretly buried Azaar.

citation.text: "Magic: The Gathering (MicroProse)/Backstory", section "The Guardian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Wizards' War Lim-Dûl's spirit, having won over Azaar's, emerges to conquer Shandalar but is defeated; the Guardian imprisons him in an artifact.
timeline.quote: In the great Wizards' War , Lim-Dûl was defeated soundly, though the Lord of the Black Guild also fell.

citation.text: "Magic: The Gathering (MicroProse)/Backstory", section "The Wizards' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Faralyn arrives on Shandalar from the Shard, mocks Tevesh Szat, Leshrac and Lim-Dûl, and claims the plane for himself.
timeline.quote: He mocks them for trying to betray him and claims Shandalar for his own.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat and Lim-Dûl arrive; Lim-Dûl is entombed in stone, and Leshrac burns him in a fire spell, causing Szat to flee.
timeline.quote: Leshrac conjures an immense fire spell and seemingly obliterates the necromancer.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The real Lim-Dûl, who was only a mana manifestation when burned, appears in the Catacombs and poses as the crone Magus to the duel sisters, who believe she is Sahrmal.
timeline.quote: As Baki and Ravash enter the Catacombs, they meet Magus and are led to believe that it is Kenan Sahrmal in disguise.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Magus sends bats; Bani is crippled by fear and Lim-Dûl casts Mind Whip on Ravash, who falls to her death. Bani vows to kill Szat.
timeline.quote: Ravash slips on the edge of a precipice and falls to her death.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sahrmal watches Lim-Dûl from the back of the catacombs, stung by Bani's words about his inaction.
timeline.quote: Unbeknownst to the necromancer, he is watched by Sarmahl himself from the back of the catacombs.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl plots to trick Sahrmal into attacking the planeswalkers, creates Manabarbs against Szat; Sahrmal joins with Fire Sprites, Szat devours Anthanor and casts Winter's Chill.
timeline.quote: The spell completely devours the soldier.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 2: The Threshold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac returns and tells Szat that Lim-Dûl is sapping him with manabarbs; the bickering planeswalkers retreat as Sahrmal casts Whimsy.
timeline.quote: Disgusted and frustrated with Shandalar's bizarre mana, Szat and Leshrac make a hasty retreat.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 2: The Threshold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl swaps bodies with Sahrmal using Mirror Universe, and Bani beheads Sahrmal's body while Lim-Dûl's essence in Sahrmal's body fades away.
timeline.quote: enough to allow Bani to slice off his head

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 2: The Threshold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bani rejects Lim-Dûl's attempt to pose as Sahrmal; Lim-Dûl spends twelve years massing undead legions before attacking Ardestan.
timeline.quote: Then his attack on Ardestan begins.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 2: The Threshold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl declares the Kjeldoran dead will kill those they loved.
timeline.quote: They shall kill those whom once they loved.

citation.text: Kjeldoran Dead (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl swears himself servant to Leshrac.
timeline.quote: I am your servant and your slave.

citation.text: Leshrac's Rite (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl calls on Leshrac for the power he is due.
timeline.quote: Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due.

citation.text: Dark Ritual (Deckmasters, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Lord of Tresserhorn's typical night as Regent for the Necromancer Lim-Dûl is described.
timeline.quote: It describes a typical night for Lord of Tresserhorn

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "A Forced Ally". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac warns Lim-Dûl's enemies will wither.
timeline.quote: Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither.

citation.text: Dark Banishing (Coldsnap Theme Decks, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl orders the dead entombed in snow so they will rise to serve.
timeline.quote: Take their dead, and entomb them in the snow.

citation.text: Drift of the Dead (Coldsnap Theme Decks, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lucilde sees her dead friends in Lim-Dûl's legion and can bear no more.
timeline.quote: I have seen the faces of my dead friends among that grim band, and I can bear no more.

citation.text: Legions of Lim-Dûl (Coldsnap Theme Decks, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chasing Lim-Dul, the White Shield sees a ridge suddenly crumble.
timeline.quote: We were chasing Lim-Dûl when the ridge in front of us suddenly crumbled.

citation.text: Glacial Crevasses (Masters Edition II, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana, a professor at Strixhaven, is visited in a dream by the Raven Man, who calls her to come home.
timeline.quote: "Come home , my Lili.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Hallucination or not, Liliana researches the Raven Man in the Biblioplex, where he appears again and urges her to search deeper.
timeline.quote: "You aren't going far enough back," he said.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds a name in A History of Terisiare, concludes the Raven Man is real, and resolves to destroy him for Gideon's sake.
timeline.quote: She could cleanse this tiny bit of evil from the Multiverse, for Gideon's sake.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana arrives at the ruined Vess estate and falls asleep under the oak in the graveyard, where the Raven Man appears in a dream.
timeline.quote: the Raven Man stood before her

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana names him Lim-Dûl and learns he wants her as Dominaria's weapon against a threat; he warns her to save herself.
timeline.quote: I called you to be Dominaria's weapon.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Elas il-Kor says her team is excavating to find an object anchoring the spirit; Liliana decides not to flee and to stop them.
timeline.quote: "The spirit we pursue is anchored to an object somewhere in this place,"

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Reaching into the ring's power, Liliana sees the history of the Raven Man's necromancer lineage and that she was meant to be the next vessel, but refuses.
timeline.quote: She had been intended as one more link in a line stretching back to that first, now-nameless mage

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man watches her leave, content that he manipulated her into protecting him.
timeline.quote: She had protected him, in the end.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Facing Lim-Dûl's undead hordes, the traditional enemies ally.
timeline.quote: the two traditional enemy lands allied to battle against his undead hordes

citation.text: "Balduvia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bani and Ravash Mog fight off undead in the Shadowwood, then find Lim-Dûl in the Catacombs, who calls himself Magus; Ravash falls into a pit.
timeline.quote: but Ravash fell into a pit due to Lim-Dûl's magic

citation.text: "Bani Bakur", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Realizing she had been used, Bani beheads Lim-Dûl.
timeline.quote: Bani, realizing she had been used, beheaded Lim-Dûl.

citation.text: "Bani Bakur", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twelve years later Lim-Dûl's undead hordes assault Ardestan, which Bani commands.
timeline.quote: she was a commander of Ardestan, and fought against Lim-Dûl's hordes of undead who assaulted the city

citation.text: "Bani Bakur", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor's spell and Lim-Dûl's counter trap both spirits within Azar's body; Sahrmal secretly buries the body to keep the Great Barrier standing.
timeline.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar’s body.

citation.text: "Bani Bakur", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Envious of Jodah, Gerda and Gustha kidnap him while his memories are stored and give him to Lim-Dûl; Gerda becomes Magus of the Unseen.
timeline.quote: Thus, Gerda became the Magus of the Unseen.

citation.text: "Gerda Äagesdotter", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sahrmal fights Tevesh Szat, Leshrac and Lim-Dûl in their first assault, sending the first two away.
timeline.quote: sending the first two away

citation.text: "Kenan Sahrmal", section "War for Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weakened, Sahrmal is attacked by Lim-Dûl while protecting Bani Bakur; his body disappears but he survives, nearly without magic, and his followers behead Lim-Dûl.
timeline.quote: having nearly no magic left

citation.text: "Kenan Sahrmal", section "War for Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twelve years later Lim-Dûl, who also survived, conquers Shandalar with an undead army until only Ardestan remains.
timeline.quote: only one city remained: Ardestan

citation.text: "Kenan Sahrmal", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar casts a stolen spell to imprison Lim-Dûl's spirit in his body; Lim-Dûl's counter traps both spirits in Azar's body.
timeline.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar’s body.

citation.text: "Kenan Sahrmal", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sahrmal secretly buries the body to preserve the Great Barrier, makes his other pupil immortal, and proclaims him successor before vanishing; the student declares himself the Guardian.
timeline.quote: “I am the Guardian, immortal protector of Shandalar.”

citation.text: "Kenan Sahrmal", section "Finding a successor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balduvians and Kjeldorans camp at the pass awaiting Lim-Dûl.
timeline.quote: The Balduvians led by Lovisa Coldeyes and the Kjeldorans led by General Varchild set up camp there

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl's Battle", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah duels Lim-Dûl, who summons Leshrac; Leshrac severs Lim-Dûl's hand and planeswalks away with him.
timeline.quote: Leshrac then severed Lim-Dûl's hand, tearing his connection with Mairsil 's ring, and planeswalked away

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl's Battle", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twelve years after the War for Shandalar, Lim-Dûl reappears with an undead army and destroys city after city until only Ardestan remains.
timeline.quote: City after city on the plane was destroyed until, after years of war, only one city remained, Ardestan .

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl's War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar prepares to cast a stolen spell to imprison Lim-Dûl's spirit and raise a Great Barrier; Lim-Dûl waits nearby.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl was prepared, however, and waited nearby.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl's War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl counters by trying to transfer into Azar's body; the combined spells trap both spirits in Azar's body and the Great Barrier comes into existence.
timeline.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar’s body.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl's War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sahrmal secretly buries Azar's body, ending the war.
timeline.quote: Saddened, Sahrmal secretly buried the body

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl's War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac takes Lim-Dûl to Shandalar, leaving Chaeska masterless.
timeline.quote: After Leshrac took Lim-Dûl with him to Shandalar

citation.text: "Lord of Tresserhorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avram Garrisson arrives and reveals he has allied with Lim-Dûl and become undead.

citation.text: "Lucilde Fiksdotter", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stromgald leads Lim-Dûl's squadron into defeat against a goblin horde, leaving Lim-Dûl the only survivor.
timeline.quote: he led Lim-Dûl 's squadron into defeat in battle against a horde of goblins , with Lim-Dûl as the only survivor.

citation.text: "Márton Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl reanimates Stromgald as a zombie and uses him to found the Order of Stromgald.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl later reanimated him as a zombie and used him to found the Order of Stromgald .

citation.text: "Márton Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stromgald is used as a symbol to incite a failed rebellion against King Darien in Krov.

citation.text: "Márton Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl dismantles Stromgald and uses his sword arm to replace Chaeska's lost one.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl had no more use for Stromgald and dismantled him

citation.text: "Márton Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar went against Sahrmal's counsel to fight Lim-Dûl alone; rescue failed and Sahrmal buried Azar's body.
timeline.quote: a grieving Sahrmal buried the body in a secret location

citation.text: "The Guardian", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Wizards' War Lim-Dûl was defeated and his soul placed in the Chain Veil.

citation.text: "The Guardian", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "War for Shandalar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "War for Shandalar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: he deceived Bani and Ravash into thinking he was Sahrmal

citation.text: "War for Shandalar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "War for Shandalar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl swaps bodies with Sahrmal as Bani strikes, and she decapitates Sahrmal's body; Sahrmal survives but is greatly diminished.

citation.text: "War for Shandalar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "War for Shandalar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
